summary: - **[key4hep/k4FWCore#413](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/413)** — `OverlayTiming` gains a `RandomMixBackgroundFiles` option for beam-induced background, which is often produced as many single-event files. When enabled, each file in a group becomes an independent event source and is drawn from a shuffled permutation that is reshuffled once exhausted, so short runs no longer see only the first few files. A bug where only one background file was used across a bunch train was found and fixed during review, and documentation and tests were added.

- **[PandoraPFAOrg/LCContent#33](https://github.com/PandoraPFAOrg/LCContent/pull/33)** — Adds Pandora particle-flow algorithms for the IDEA option 2 detector, including ECAL-seeded HCAL clustering, IDEA PFO creation, forward photon ID and a dual-readout correction plugin. Two ONNX-based ML algorithms (neutral cluster PID and satellite cluster merging) build only with `LCContent_BUILD_ML=ON`. Requires PandoraSDK ≥ 04.00.01, and the new algorithms are not registered by default, so clients must register them.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#127](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/127)** — Fixes outside-in CKF (`PropagateBackward`), which started at the innermost seed space point and dropped the outer seed hits from final tracks. It now starts at the outermost point, outputs tracks in inside-out order, stops at the reference surface and labels seed states `AtLastHit`. Seed parameters and the magnetic field are now evaluated at the start space point, which also affects the default inside-out seeding.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1706](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1706)** — Fixes volume divisions, which did not assign volume and placement extensions. The missing extensions caused null-pointer exceptions when traversing the volume hierarchy of divided volumes.

- **[key4hep/k4geo#669](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/669)** — Adds the first version of the ALFA detector concept for FCC-ee (`ALFA_o1_v00`). It includes a Grainita ECAL barrel driver with a dedicated sensitive-detector action, an outer tracker barrel, an extended vertex barrel constructor, `FCCSWGridRhoPhiTheta` segmentation, a steering file and tests.

- **[key4hep/k4geo#674](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/674)** — `ALLEGRO_o1_v04` now includes `DectDimensions` and other common files directly from `ALLEGRO_o1_v03`, keeping only its own HCAL files. This guarantees identical properties, such as the silicon wrapper, between the two versions and avoids divergent copies like the one behind k4geo#673.

- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config#402](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/402)** — Adds a `siDigitizer` option to the ALLEGRO digi/reco steering to use the new `VTXdigitizerDetailed` instead of `DDPlanarDigi` for silicon detectors. Pixel pitches are now parsed from the compact files as the single source of truth, while `DDPlanarDigi` resolutions can still be overridden. Digitiser thresholds and smearing settings still need tuning.

- **[hep-fcc/k4RecCalorimeter#291](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter/pull/291)** — `TopoCaloNoisyCells` now stores noise data as an indexed vector instead of a hash map, which is faster and smaller. The data is shared through `CaloCellConstantsSvc` to avoid duplication when the tool is configured multiple times, and ALLEGRO reconstruction output is verified unchanged.

- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config#407](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/407)** — The IDEA `run_digi_reco.py` previously re-downloaded the ~65 MB GGTF model on every `k4run`. It now takes the model path from a new `--trackingModel` option (default unchanged) and downloads atomically from `fccsw.web.cern.ch` only if the file is missing. This removes the network dependency for cached runs and keeps the download out of k4Bench timing.

- **[key4hep/key4hep-spack#940](https://github.com/key4hep/key4hep-spack/pull/940)** — The nightlies setup script gains a `--latest-tags` option that sources the LCG `devkey` view, using the same platforms and options as `devkey-head`.

- **[key4hep/k4Opt#18](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Opt/pull/18)** — Adds the first end-to-end `k4opt evaluate` command for detector optimisation. It materialises a candidate geometry, runs `ddsim`, measures ECAL hit multiplicity from the EDM4hep output and writes a `summary.json` with the measurement, geometry fingerprint, exact ddsim command and environment provenance.

- **[hep-fcc/fcc-physics-events#30](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/fcc-physics-events/pull/30)** — Datasets created through the single-record form now require a validated DRS request reference (`DRS-<number>`). Creating new navigation values (accelerator, campaign, etc.) now requires admin rights, enforced server-side.
